# HackerRank

> HackerRank is a technical hiring platform offering developer assessments, AI-powered interviews, and skills certification across 260+ programming skills.

The platform provides end-to-end solutions for technical recruitment through its Screen, Interview, Engage, and SkillUp products, featuring AI interviewer Chakra, real-world coding assessments, and plagiarism detection. HackerRank serves enterprises with ATS integrations and certified assessments to streamline developer hiring.

## Key Topics

- Screen (assessment product)
- Interview (live interview product)
- Engage (developer branding)
- SkillUp (certification platform)
- Chakra (AI interviewer)
- Real-World Questions
- Plagiarism Detection
- Certified Assessments
- ATS integrations
- 2025 Developer Skills Report
- Technical assessments
- AI-assisted interviews
- Auto-grading
- 260+ skills coverage

## Core Products & Features

- [Chakra | AI Interviewer](https://www.hackerrank.com/features/ai-interviewer): Chakra AI interviewer: automated technical interviews with integrity checks
- [Engage - Showcase your tech brand - HackerRank](https://www.hackerrank.com/products/engage): Engage product: developer branding through coding events and hackathons
- [HackerRank Enterprise Plan Features](https://www.hackerrank.com/about-us/enterprise-plan): Enterprise plan features for Screen, Interview, and Engage products
- [Our Team](https://www.hackerrank.com/about-us/our-team): Leadership team including Vivek Ravisankar and executives
